um Hilfe bitten könnt.$k

$SbpSTRM_BGM_EVT_MYUNIT1|0|$t1$Wmロラン|7$w0|$Wsロラン|$Wa$Wmusername|3$w0|$Wsロラン|$Wa$E通常,|$SvpSE_VOICE_LAURENT_EVT_6|$Nu, j'en ai fini ici.
Y a-t-il autre chose que je puisse faire ?$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$E通常,|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_F#_EVT_14|Non, je crois que c'est tout. On dirait que
tu as fini de travailler pour aujourd'hui.$k
$Wsロラン|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_LAURENT_EVT_2|Je suis heureux de pouvoir vous aider et
veiller à ce que vous ne vous épuisiez pas.$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$E笑,|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_F#_EVT_16|Ça me fait plaisir. Cela m'a servi de leçon
que tu me grondes.$k
$Wsロラン|$Wa$E苦,汗|$SvpSE_VOICE_LAURENT_EVT_9|Je suis désolé si je vous ai rudoyée.
Ce n'était pas approprié.$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$E通常,|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_F#_EVT_20|Ce n'est pas grave. Je sais que tu te
préoccupais de la santé de ton amie...$k
$Wsロラン|$Wa$E通常,|$SvpSE_VOICE_LAURENT_EVT_2|C'était en partie pour cela, oui. Je me
soucie beaucoup du bien-être de mes amis.$k$pMais dans votre cas, cela va plus loin que
ça. Vous êtes... plus qu'une simple amie.$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_F#_EVT_5|Que veux-tu dire ?$k
$Wsロラン|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_LAURENT_EVT_8|Au début, je vous admirais pour vos talents
de stratège. Un intérêt purement technique.$k$pMais en passant du temps avec vous, j'ai
appris à mieux vous connaître.$k$pJe vois maintenant la femme formidable
que vous êtes.$k$pC'est pour cela que je veux être avec vous.
Pour toujours.$k$p$E通常,照|Mon rêve serait d'être l'homme qui sera
à vos côtés pour l'éternité.$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$E笑,照|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_F#_EVT_17|Oh, Laurent... !
Rien ne me ferait plus plaisir !$k
$Wsロラン|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_LAURENT_EVT_17|Formidable !$k

$SbpSTRM_BGM_EVT_MYUNIT1|0|$t1$Wmロラン|7$w0|$Wsロラン|$Wa$Wmusername|3$w0|$Wsロラン|$Wa$E通常,|$SvpSE_VOICE_LAURENT_EVT_6|$Nu, ich bin fertig. Kann ich
sonst noch etwas für Euch tun?$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$E通常,|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_F#_EVT_14|Nein, das wäre alles. Anscheinend hast du
alle Aufgaben für heute erledigt.$k
$Wsロラン|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_LAURENT_EVT_2|Ich freue mich, Euch zu Diensten zu sein und
Euch vor Überanstrengung zu bewahren.$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$E笑,|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_F#_EVT_16|Ich freue mich auch. Dein Rüffel von neulich
hat mir endlich die Augen geöffnet.$k
$Wsロラン|$Wa$E苦,汗|$SvpSE_VOICE_LAURENT_EVT_9|Verzeiht, wenn ich etwas harsch war.
Dergleichen steht mir wohl kaum zu.$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$E通常,|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_F#_EVT_20|Schon gut. Du wurdest schließlich von der
Sorge um eine Freundin getrieben.$k
$Wsロラン|$Wa$E通常,|$SvpSE_VOICE_LAURENT_EVT_2|Teilweise sicherlich. Ich bin stets um das
Wohl meiner Freunde besorgt.$k$pAber Euer Fall ist komplexer. Ihr seid
mehr als nur... eine Freundin.$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_F#_EVT_5|Was? ...Wie meinst du das?$k
$Wsロラン|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_LAURENT_EVT_8|Zu Beginn bewunderte ich Euch lediglich als
Taktikerin und zeigte berufliches Interesse.$k$pDoch im Laufe der Zeit lernte ich Euch
immer besser kennen.$k$pIch sehe nun, was für eine wundervolle Frau
Ihr doch seid.$k$pUnd genau aus diesem Grund möchte ich
mit Euch zusammen sein... Für immer.$k$p$E通常,照|Mein Traum ist es, bis ans Ende aller Tage
der Mann an Eurer Seite zu sein.$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$E笑,照|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_F#_EVT_17|...Oh, Laurent! Nichts würde mich
glücklicher machen!$k
$Wsロラン|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_LAURENT_EVT_17|Excelsior!$k

$SbpSTRM_BGM_EVT_MYUNIT1|0|$t1$Wmロラン|7$w0|$Wsロラン|$Wa$Wmusername|3$w0|$Wsロラン|$Wa$E通常,|$SvpSE_VOICE_LAURENT_EVT_6|$Nu, qui ho terminato.
Posso fare qualcos'altro?$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$E通常,|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_F#_EVT_14|No, credo sia tutto. Direi che per
oggi il nostro lavoro è finito.$k
$Wsロラン|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_LAURENT_EVT_2|Sono felice di potervi aiutare. È importante
che non vi affatichiate troppo.$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$E笑,|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_F#_EVT_16|Lo so. Ho imparato la lezione,
grazie alla tua ramanzina.$k
$Wsロラン|$Wa$E苦,汗|$SvpSE_VOICE_LAURENT_EVT_9|Perdonate se sono stato troppo brusco.
Ho agito in modo inappropriato.$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$E通常,|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_F#_EVT_20|Non preoccuparti. So che lo hai fatto
perché tieni alla salute di un'amica.$k
$Wsロラン|$Wa$E通常,|$SvpSE_VOICE_LAURENT_EVT_2|Sì, è vero. La salute dei miei amici
mi sta particolarmente a cuore.$k$pMa il vostro caso è ben diverso.
Voi siete... più di un'amica per me.$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_F#_EVT_5|Che intendi dire?$k
$Wsロラン|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_LAURENT_EVT_8|All'inizio, vi ammiravo solo come stratega.
Il mio era un interesse professionale.$k$pMa col tempo, ho imparato a
conoscervi sempre meglio.$k$pAdesso mi rendo conto di quanto siate
meravigliosa anche come donna.$k$pEcco perché vorrei stare
con voi... per sempre.$k$p$E通常,照|Il mio sogno è essere l'uomo che sarà al
vostro fianco fino alla fine dei nostri giorni.$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$E笑,照|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_F#_EVT_17|Oh, Laurent! Niente mi
renderebbe più felice!$k
$Wsロラン|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_LAURENT_EVT_17|Hocus pocus!$k

$SbpSTRM_BGM_EVT_MYUNIT1|0|$t1$Wmロラン|7$w0|$Wsロラン|$Wa$Wmusername|3$w0|$Wsロラン|$Wa$E通常,|$SvpSE_VOICE_LAURENT_EVT_6|$Nu, ya he terminado.
¿Hay algo más que pueda hacer?$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$E通常,|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_F#_EVT_14|No, creo que eso es todo. Parece que
hemos acabado con las tareas de hoy.$k
$Wsロラン|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_LAURENT_EVT_2|Me agrada saber que te estoy ayudando y
que estoy evitando que trabajes demasiado.$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$E笑,|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_F#_EVT_16|Yo también estoy contenta... Esa regañina
que me echaste me hacía mucha falta.$k
$Wsロラン|$Wa$E苦,汗|$SvpSE_VOICE_LAURENT_EVT_9|Lamento haber sido tan brusco. A fin de
cuentas, no soy nadie para criticarte.$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$E通常,|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_F#_EVT_20|Tranquilo, sé que lo has hecho porque eres
mi amigo y te preocupas por mí.$k
$Wsロラン|$Wa$E通常,|$SvpSE_VOICE_LAURENT_EVT_2|Es cierto, soy tu amigo. Y me preocupo por
mis amigos y trato de cuidar de ellos.$k$pPero en tu caso... siento algo más.
Para mí eres... mucho más que una amiga.$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_F#_EVT_5|¿Cómo? ¿Qué quieres decir?$k
$Wsロラン|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_LAURENT_EVT_8|Al principio solo te admiraba como
estratega. Mi interés era profesional.$k$pPero a medida que hemos pasado tiempo
juntos, te he ido conociendo mejor...$k$pAhora veo que también eres una mujer
maravillosa...$k$pY por eso quiero estar contigo... para
siempre.$k$p$E通常,照|Mi sueño es convertirme en el hombre que
estará a tu lado hasta el fin de los días.$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$E笑,照|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_F#_EVT_17|¡Oh, Laurent! ¡Nada me
haría más feliz!$k
$Wsロラン|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_LAURENT_EVT_17|¡Excelente!$k

$SbpSTRM_BGM_EVT_MYUNIT1|0|$t1$Wmロラン|7$w0|$Wsロラン|$Wa$Wmusername|3$w0|$Wsロラン|$Wa$E通常,|$SvpSE_VOICE_LAURENT_EVT_6|$Nu, I'm finished here.
Is there anything else I can do?$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$E通常,|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_F#_EVT_14|No, I think that's it. Looks like all
our chores are done for the day.$k
$Wsロラン|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_LAURENT_EVT_2|I'm glad I was able to assist and ensure
you didn't overwork yourself.$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$E笑,|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_F#_EVT_16|I'm glad, too... That scolding you
gave me finally set me straight.$k
$Wsロラン|$Wa$E苦,汗|$SvpSE_VOICE_LAURENT_EVT_9|I'm sorry if I spoke harshly.
It was hardly my place.$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$E通常,|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_F#_EVT_20|It's okay. I know it was all out
of friendly concern.$k
$Wsロラン|$Wa$E通常,|$SvpSE_VOICE_LAURENT_EVT_2|That was certainly part of it, yes. I care
for my friends and hope to keep them well.$k$pBut, in your case, it...goes deeper.
You are...more than just a friend to me.$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_F#_EVT_5|What? ...What do you mean?$k
$Wsロラン|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_LAURENT_EVT_8|In the beginning, I admired you solely as a
tactician. My interest was professional.$k$pBut as we've spent more time together,
I've come to know you better...$k$pI see now what a wonderful woman you
are as well...$k$pAnd that is why...I want to be with you.
Forever.$k$p$E通常,照|My dream is to be the man at your side
from now until the end of days.$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$E笑,照|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_F#_EVT_17|Oh, Laurent! Nothing would
make me happier!$k
$Wsロラン|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_LAURENT_EVT_17|Excelsior!$k

Yapabileceğim başka bir şey var mı?$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$E通常|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_F#_EVT_14|Hayır, sanırım bu kadar. Bugünkü
tüm işlerimiz bitmiş görünüyor.$k
$Wsロラン|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_LAURENT_EVT_2|Sana yardım edip kendini fazla
yormamanı sağlayabildiğime sevindim.$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$E笑|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_F#_EVT_16|Ben de sevindim... Azarlaman
sonunda aklımı başıma getirdi.$k
$Wsロラン|$Wa$E苦,汗|$SvpSE_VOICE_LAURENT_EVT_9|Sert konuştuysam özür dilerim.
Belki de haddimi aştım.$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$E通常|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_F#_EVT_20|Sorun değil. Bunun arkadaşça bir
endişeden kaynaklandığını biliyorum.$k
$Wsロラン|$Wa$E通常|$SvpSE_VOICE_LAURENT_EVT_2|Evet, o da vardı. Dostlarımı önemserim;
iyi olmalarını isterim.$k$pAma senin durumunda hislerim daha derin.
Sen... benim için bir arkadaştan fazlasısın.$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_F#_EVT_5|Ne? ...Ne demek istiyorsun?$k
$Wsロラン|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_LAURENT_EVT_8|Başlangıçta sana yalnızca bir taktikçi
olarak hayrandım. İlgim profesyoneldi.$k$pAma birlikte daha fazla zaman geçirdikçe
seni daha iyi tanımaya başladım...$k$pŞimdi senin de ne kadar harika bir kadın
olduğunu görüyorum...$k$pİşte bu yüzden... seninle olmak istiyorum.
Sonsuza dek.$k$p$E通常,照|Hayalim, ömrümün sonuna kadar
yanındaki adam olmak.$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$E笑,照|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_F#_EVT_17|Ah, Laurent! Hiçbir şey beni
daha mutlu edemez!$k
$Wsロラン|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_LAURENT_EVT_17|Mükemmel!$k
